description: Measure a recording's structure so segmentation stops being guesswork: framewise audio energy with percentile floor/speech estimates and gap populations, four independent frame-difference metrics, scene detection with per-scene evidence, a measured picture-leads-words distribution, and a plan() that chooses audio-led / video-led / hybrid — or refuses.
why: narrated-review v0.1.4 segmented a real 4m21s screencast into nine slices of exactly 30000 ms, because a fixed absolute RMS silence threshold (0.01) sat BELOW that recording's noise floor, so no frame ever counted as silence. The defect was not the constant — it was that nothing plotted the distribution it was being compared against. This module exists to make that visible, and to make every threshold per-recording.

files.note: framewise rms/dBFS/spectral-flatness. Flatness distinguishes 'quiet but noisy' (room tone, mains hum) from 'quiet and empty' — the case that defeats an absolute RMS threshold.
THE core of the tool. thresholdTable() evaluates every candidate threshold at once, replaying the REAL createVad, so 'topicGaps: 0, capped: 8' is a one-glance diagnosis.
meanAbs · blockMax · edgeDiff · histDist on a 32x18 raster matching nr-frames.js. Four rather than one because the single hardcoded metric was never examined.
two-pass video sweep (coarse everywhere, fine only where something moved), cancellable, with a wall-clock estimate before committing. Recovers duration from a header-less MediaRecorder WebM.

per-recording thresholds (a multiple of that metric's own p95), bursts collapsed to the settled frame, and every scene carries its evidence. compareMetrics answers 'which metric should we use?' empirically.
measures how far the picture leads the words instead of assuming 2500/1200, and reports whether the two signals are correlated at all.
audio-led | video-led | hybrid | none. Every cut carries evidence; 'none' is a legitimate answer. Cost constants are measured from a real session, named in COST_BASIS.

OPTIONAL cross-check via silencedetect / select=gt(scene,N) / ebur128 at native frame rate, plus HEVC coverage. Retains the raw log; a parse yielding nothing reports 'ffmpeg-parse', never 'found nothing'. NOT verified in a browser — needs the unpkg CDN.

dependencies.note: core/sg-live-capture createVad is NOT imported — the caller injects a replay function, so the module never depends on the pipeline it measures.

browser.network: none — no model calls, no uploads. The FFmpeg lane is the only thing that fetches, and only when explicitly run.

consumers: tools/narrated-review (planned — gated on validation against three real recordings)
limitations: Percentile choices (p20 floor, p90 speech, 15%/40% thresholds) and the scene factor (1.5x p95) are starting points validated on synthetic clips and one real session, not tuned across a corpus.
spectralFlatness uses a decimated DFT on 1-in-5 frames — enough for a ratio, not a spectrum.
The FFmpeg lane has never been run in a browser here (CDN unreachable in the build container); its log parsers are covered by unit tests against captured text.
